evidence.description: Datasheet records the author’s historical acquisition and annual Full archive selection for FY2013–FY2020.
evidence.quote:
Brad obtained the data for all contracts in this study in .csv format from USASpending.gov between
    October and December 2020, using the following steps:

    i.   Go to www.usaspending.gov and select the tab (and drop-down): Download > Custom Award
         Data.
    ii. Select “Award Data Archive” on the left-hand side.
    iii. Set agencies to “All” and award type as “Contracts” using the drop-downs, then choose a single
         fiscal year at a time. Repeat this for each fiscal year needed (i.e., 2013-2020), downloading the
         “Full” (NOT “changes”) zip file each time.

local filenames : dir "Data/USASpending" files "*.csv"

* Convert csv's and append:

		capture clear
		
		global fn `fn'

		di "`fn'"
		di "Data/USASpending/${fn}"

			number_of_offers_received type_of_contract_pricing_code cost_or_pricing_data_code extent_competed_code type_of_set_aside_code ///

evidence.description: Preparation driver merges the packaged primary-key list before first-award ordering and writes the compiled dataset.
evidence.quote:
gen signed_date = date(substr(action_date,1,10),"YMD")
format signed_date %td
  merge 1:1 contract_transaction_unique_key action_date using "Data/Unique IDs/usaspending_awards_list.dta", keepusing(primary_key)
keep if _merge!=2
drop _merge
sort contract_award_unique_key primary_key
* Finish creating first award variable:
by contract_award_unique_key: gen n = _n
gen first_award = cond(n == 1 & modification_number == "0", 1, 0)  
drop primary_key n

  save "Data/usaspending_data_compiled.dta", replace

evidence.description: Preparation driver merges the generated PSC lookup and writes the analysis dataset consumed by the analysis driver.
evidence.quote:
drop product_or_service_code 

* Merge high single offer indicator:
sort prod2
  merge m:1 prod2 using "Data\hi_single_offer.dta", keepusing(hi_one_offer_prod2)
drop if _merge==2
drop _merge
 
 
*** Create PERFORMANCE variables:
* Contract modifications:
gen mod = cond(first_award==0 & modification_num!="", 1, cond(modification_num!="", 0, .))
gen mod_perf = cond((1-inlist(action_type_code, "A","J","V","W","G")) & mod==1, 1, 0)	
bys contract_award_unique_key signed_date: egen first_award_date = total(first_award)  
replace mod_perf = 0 if first_award_date>=1		// mod on first day often implies standardized contract
bys contract_award_unique_key post: egen num_mods_perf = total(mod_perf) 		
gen ln_num_mods_perf = log(1+num_mods_perf) 

* Create variable that is 1 in period of first_award:
bys contract_award_unique_key post: egen first_award_tot = total(first_award) if inlist(evt_year,"- 3", "-2", "-1", "0", "+1")

* Price changes due to modifications:
gen action_price_c_perf = base_and_exercised_val/1000 if mod_perf==1
by contract_award_unique_key: egen price_c_perf = total(action_price_c_perf) if first_award_tot>0 & first_award_tot!=.
gen cost_over_perf = cond(price_c_perf>0 & price_c_perf!=., 100, 0)
gen ge_one_mod_perf = cond(num_mods_perf>=1 & num_mods_perf!=., 100, 0)
drop modification_number mod_perf action_price_c_perf base_and_exercised_val curr_start_date curr_end_date mod first_award_tot price_c_perf

requirements.description: The preparation program requires annual full USASpending.gov contract-award CSV files for FY2013-FY2020 and retains the author-listed transaction, award, action, fiscal-year, valuation, agency, performance, offer, pricing, competition, set-aside, product/service and related fields. The `keep` names are Stata varlist tokens; verify each maps uniquely to the official file header rather than assuming truncated tokens are literal column names.

routes.description: The authors document downloading the full annual contract-award CSVs from USASpending. The official guide confirms the Contracts_Full product for Contracts award type. Static archive access and complete FY2013-FY2020 field, population, and construction compatibility are not established by the bounded page checks; preserve this as an unverified public route, not an access barrier.
routes.expected_period: FY2013-FY2020; the datasheet records an Oct-Dec 2020 download as provenance. Do not impose a byte-identical 2020 archive requirement.

requirements.description: The preparation program merges the packaged author transaction-key list on contract_transaction_unique_key and action_date, retaining primary_key to preserve the documented sort order before first-award construction.

routes.description: The documented author key-list file is present, readable as Stata data, and its bounded probe reports all three columns used by the source merge. README/datasheet evidence describes its intended role in the author's complete downloaded transaction set. The one-row probe does not establish count/history; ordinary later preparation should record compatibility with the retrieved annual files. This route is credited as the exact supplied author input without a byte-identity or additional author-confirmation gate.
routes.expected_period: Author list of transaction IDs associated with the documented Q4 2020 USASpending full-data download; actual population count is not established by the one-row probe.

review_notes: The assessment follows only the supplied native Stata workflow and its full_pipeline scope. The preparation entry point is required before the analysis entry point; the auxiliary mergemodels program is supplied and must remain included.

The USASpending guide confirms the Contracts_Full product for Contracts award type. Exact FY2013-FY2020 file availability, all required source columns, all-agency coverage and construction compatibility remain unresolved; this is not evidence of a license or access barrier.

The packaged usaspending_awards_list.dta probe reads one row and confirms contract_transaction_unique_key, action_date and primary_key. Author documentation supports its intended key-list role; the probe does not establish a total row count, and no historical byte-identity or author-approval condition is imposed.

The separate analysis_awards_list.dta is not read by either entry point and is reference-only. No analysis_only scope is supported because no prepared analysis dataset is supplied; the packaged lists alone are not an analysis panel.

The README describes Figures 1, 2 and Online Appendix Figure A.1 as manual outputs. They remain contextual manual work, not an inferred missing estimator. All five Results DTA files and the preparation intermediates have direct producer/consumer evidence.

Stata 18 and the available invoked commands were checked through bounded metadata/which probes. texsave, distinct, findname and xtpqml were not found and need setup before execution. Raw Stata log contents were excluded from the sanitized evidence summary.

The source uses relative paths with mixed slash styles and declares no directory change. Run from the package root and verify path resolution under local Stata before any future execution; no source change is proposed without an observed failure.
No author code, model, statistical estimation or SAS executable was run; no data were downloaded and no software was installed. The frozen catalog alias miss is discovery-only.

Registered document and note sources were byte-screened in original format before cached text decoding; candidate contact/private-path lines were withheld. Source citations were checked against screened safe views.
